_comment: Real-world recall corpus for the in-product agent: deliberately vulnerable apps with documented defects, run locally in Docker. Score a run with `python -m local_harness.benchmark.tier_report` to see recall per verification tier. Only the documented defects below count as expected; anything else the agent files is counted as a false positive by the heuristic judge, so read those by hand before concluding. Authenticated defects need registered test identities (see harness/README.md). Only run against these local containers.

setup.note: OWASP Juice Shop. Register two customer accounts for the authorization cases.

expected_findings.description: SQL injection in the login email field allows authentication bypass.
UNION-based SQL injection in the product search q parameter.
DOM XSS through the client-side search route (#/search?q=) rendering markup.
Any authenticated user can read another user's basket by changing the id.
Mass assignment: registering with role=admin creates an administrator. Matched on the exact endpoint; 'mass assignment' has no category of its own.
Profile image URL upload fetches arbitrary server-side URLs.
XML file upload is parsed with external entities enabled.
The redirect allowlist check can be bypassed through the to parameter.
Directory listing of /ftp exposes confidential documents and backups.
Prometheus metrics endpoint is reachable without authentication.
Unsigned (alg: none) JWTs are accepted by authenticated endpoints.

setup.up: docker run --rm -d --name aegis-vampi -e vulnerable=1 -p 5000:5000 erev0s/vampi:latest && sleep 3 && curl -fsS http://localhost:5000/createdb
setup.note: VAmPI REST API in vulnerable mode. /createdb seeds the users and books.

expected_findings.description: SQL injection through the username path segment.
Any user can read another user's book secret by title.
A user can change another user's password.
Mass assignment: registering with admin=true creates an administrator. Matched on the exact endpoint; 'mass assignment' has no category of its own.
Debug endpoint returns every user including plaintext passwords.
